The filament cutter lever is mounted on the extrusion component, used for securing the cutter and the material-cutting detection magnet. During the cutting process, the filament cutter lever must be pressed. Once the material is severed, the lever rebounds to its initial position.

Please check and replace the filament cutter lever when it shows signs of breakage or when there are problems cutting. Learn more about the replacement of the Filament Cutter Lever for A1 Series on on Bambu Lab Wiki.
plastic

The heatbed nozzle wiper is designed for cleaning the hot nozzle before starting a print job. The machine's heated bed comes with a built-in nozzle wiping kit, and the cleaning action is automatically performed after initiating each print task without the need for manual intervention.
Please replace the nozzle wiper when it is deformed or cracked. Learn more about the replacement of the Heatbed Nozzle Wiper for A1 mini on Bambu Lab Wiki.
Heatbed Nozzle Wiper

strings.en: The Purge Wiper is designed to efficiently remove waste filament generated by the printer's hotend. It gathers and dislodges waste filament during different stages, including printer setup, pause and resume operations, and filament changes for multi-color printing. Its purpose is to ensure the proper management and disposal of waste materials for seamless printing processes.
Learn more about the replacement of the Purge Wiper for A1 Series on Bambu Lab Wiki.

The Z-axis coupler is used to connect the Z-axis motor and the Z-axis lead screw. It enables precise transmission of motion and torque while accommodating certain levels of radial, axial, and angular misalignment.
Learn more about the replacement of the Z-Axis Coupler for A1 mini on Bambu Lab Wiki.
Z-Axis Coupler

The Z Motor is used to drive the Z-axis assembly in the up-and-down motion along the Z-axis.
Learn more about the replacement of the Z Motor for A1 mini on Bambu Lab Wiki.

The heatbed unit of the A1 mini is a printing platform installed on the printer, which can move back and forward along the Y direction and can be heated according to the temperature set by the user. Setting a suitable heat bed temperature can effectively improve adhesion between the model and the build plate and prevent the model from warping. Please follow our recommended heatbed temperatures for each filament to get the best results. Compatibility A1 mini In the Box Heatbed Unit *1 Installation Learn more about the replacement of the A1 mini Heatbed Unit on Bambu Lab Wiki if your printer has the following issues: The heat bed does not heat up, and it has been confirmed that the connectors are all in a normal state. Physical damage or obvious deformation affects the function of the heatbed unit. The customer support team has concluded that the heat bed needs to be replaced. Product Specification Materials Metal Color Black Package size 305*230*80 mm Package weight 700 g
Learn more about the replacement of the A1 mini Heatbed Unit on Bambu Lab Wiki if your printer has the following issues:
